summary: This is a routine Form 424B5 prospectus supplement for a small best-efforts public offering of 500,000 ADSs by YXT.com Group Holding Limited, each ADS representing 30 Class A ordinary shares, at a purchase price of $3.00 per ADS, for gross proceeds of $1.5 million. The offering is conducted under General Instruction I.B.5 of Form F-3, subject to public float limits. Univest Securities acts as placement agent on a reasonable-best-efforts basis, with no minimum offering requirement. This is an ordinary capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
